title: Academic interests & research
text:
I’m interested in how people form political opinions, how governments respond, and how data can help us understand these relationships.

Public opinion: How do people evaluate politicians and their performance?
Elections and polarization: What shapes voting preferences, and why do political opinions become divided?
Latin America: How do political and economic decisions influence development and inequality?
Local government: How do cities respond to community needs and translate policy into everyday outcomes?

title: Academic interests & research
text:
Applied Data Analysis Coursework

Empirical Approaches (Political Science Research Methods): Using data and statistical methods to investigate political questions, focus on election data, ANES 2024.
Advanced Empirical Approaches (Advanced Political Science Research Methods): Applying advanced statistical methods to political research, focus on global datasets, WDI, Gapminder, ACS, and OWID.
Computational Social Science: Using programming and computational methods to analyze social and political questions, focus on text and image analysis. ## Past projects


Past quantitative project: Foreign direct investment and income inequality in Latin America
QUANTITATIVE RESEARCH · LATIN AMERICA
Question. What is the relationship between foreign direct investment and income inequality in Latin America?
Approach. Used an ordinary least squares (OLS) regression model to examine the relationship between FDI and income inequality.
Focus. Exploring whether foreign investment is associated with differences in income inequality across the Latin American countries studied.

title: Home
text:
STUDENT & RESEARCHER


Making sense of the social world.
I’m an undergraduate student at Loyola Marymount University studying political science and economics, with a focus on applied data science.
I’m interested in politics, public opinion, and local government, and in how I can use data and research methods to deepen my understanding and improve my work.
This is a place for my projects, the questions I’m working through, and a few notes from beyond the classroom.
